title: 第134章 宗师做不到的事，他做到了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸怔住。狗皇帝这么阴险的吗？估计那些背叛的大臣，现在还在庆幸皇帝将他们忘记了。殊不知皇帝这老阴批，哪里是忘记他们，是已经想着名正言顺将他们抄家，不仅要他们的命，还要他们的钱。这时候唐逸才真的相信，皇帝是真的穷疯了！“唐逸，恭喜啊！”这时，孔诗岚已经走到唐逸面前，俏脸有些复杂：“恭喜你获得沈园诗会第一名，恭喜你……嗯，侯爷？”唐逸没有注意到孔诗岚的情绪，笑着摆了摆手道：“唐姑娘还是叫我唐逸吧，什么侯爷大人的，我听着也不舒服。”说到这里他拱了拱手，道：“也恭喜姑娘了，终于得偿所愿，以后可以婚嫁自由了。”听到这话，孔诗岚指尖下意识颤了颤，连呼吸也出现了短暂的迟滞。是啊，终于得偿所愿了。可是，她和眼前这充满谜团的少年，却真的再没有任何关系了。“不好意思，我先走了。”唐逸笑着和孔诗岚拱手告别，便快步离开了栈桥。唐音和杜凌菲已经等在栈桥外了。经过孔诗岚身边的时候，孔诗岚下意识想要伸手拦他。但手还没提起，就已经先僵住了。留？她有什么借口和理由留唐逸呢？当初说了不嫁唐逸的是她，说了想要婚约自幼不接受指婚的也是她。抬头看着少年渐行渐远的背影，孔诗岚微微抿唇，心乱得一塌糊涂。“哥，我要吃烤鸭，杜姐姐说她知道京都有一家好吃的烤鸭店。”唐逸刚走到河边，唐音双手叉腰仰着头盯着他：“不许拒绝，咱们这是在庆祝，庆祝哥哥你官升一二三四……”她伸出两根手指头，比画了半天没数清楚。有些烦躁地甩了甩小手，唐音气鼓鼓：“哎呀，数数什么的烦死了，总之就是官升很多很多级，娘不在了，我得给哥哥庆祝。”唐逸看向杜凌菲，杜凌菲当即笑着摇头：“这可不是我教的，我发誓。”唐逸：呵呵！你要不加发誓两个字，说不定我还真信了。发誓都是骗人的。“既然是庆祝，那咱们自己买菜回去做吧，我给你们下厨。”唐逸将唐音抱起来，却发现这小家伙重了不少，顿时没好气：“你吃了多少？你的胃现在还经不起这么折腾，你给我悠着点。”唐音立即向杜凌菲求救。杜凌菲跟在唐逸身侧，掩唇笑道：“也没吃多少，就吃光了两桌而已，其中一桌还是陛下的。”“吃就算了，她还很贴心私下一只鸡腿给陛下，陛下还接了。”“你没看到，陈貂寺那张脸当时有多精彩……”听到杜凌菲告状，唐音立即把脑袋埋在唐逸的脖子中，表示自己知道错了。三人上了石桥后，唐逸甚至贴心拉着杜凌菲，怕她被暗京楼杀手的断臂残骸吓到。孔诗岚远远看着这一幕，微微抿着唇，心底竟然莫名的有一些羡慕。“不行，回宫之后，我就让母妃将杜姐姐调回宫里去。”身侧传来萧澜咬牙切齿的声音。孔诗岚扭头，看到萧澜站在身侧，正攥着粉拳盯着远去的唐逸和杜凌菲。“调回宫里？杜姑娘是贤妃娘娘派来照顾唐音的，同时，也是来帮助唐逸培养那……那什么青霉素菌的。”孔诗岚收敛情绪，抬手在萧岚额头上敲了一下，道：“别胡闹，青霉素溶液为唯一能治你的病的药，不容出现半点差错。”“走吧，沈园现在充满血腥气，你待在这里不好。”萧澜看着唐逸和杜凌菲的背影撅了撅嘴，气得跺了跺脚。好讨厌呀。好不容易从孔姐姐的嘴里夺食，现在杜姐姐又冒出来争食，抢他孩子他爹。……天香楼。侧面，魏渊手持酒壶，依旧坐在老槐树下。在他对面，一个坐在轮椅上的女孩，正捧一本书在认真的看，魏渊就盯着他，脸上满是慈爱和宠溺。“老祖宗，沈园那边有消息了。”这时，魏海快步走了过来。在槐树下停下脚步，魏海下意识看向女孩，欲言又止。魏渊扬了扬手，道：“没关系，说吧，不用背着灵儿。”“倒是比我预测的要快一些，看来陛下这次准备的很充足。”听到这话，魏海脸色顿时怪异起来。他摇了摇头，道：“老祖宗，和陛下没太大关系……暗京楼还没大开杀戒，就先被唐逸给杀得几乎全军覆没了。”“嗯？！”魏渊猛地抬起头，眼神瞬间犀利起来。暗京楼还没大开杀戒，就被唐逸杀得全军覆没了？开什么玩笑？暗京楼为了杀炎文帝，可是几乎出动了一半精锐，别说踏平一个沈园，就是血洗皇宫都不是什么难事。结果，被唐逸给团灭了？那家伙有这么大本事？那小子明明半点武功都不会好吧！就连魏灵儿，这时也抬起头，一双漂亮的大眼睛盯着魏海。小诗仙这么厉害吗？不仅诗词写得好，武功也这么厉害？“消息确定了吗？”魏渊回过神，声音低沉。魏海用力点头，脸上已经带着难以置信和震撼，他得到消息的时候，也觉得一定是搞错了。唐逸一个小小的锦衣卫百户，他灭了暗京楼？听上去就很扯淡。可综合各方面消息，他不得不承认，这个扯淡的事情特妈是事实。唐逸真一战干趴下了暗京楼上百高手！“已经确定了的，是唐逸没错。”魏海看向魏渊，指着天空道：“我们之前听到的雷声，不是雷声，是唐逸搞出来的炸雷……怎么说呢？就是这些炸雷吧，是唐逸引来的。”“他这么一刀，说是让刀气飞一会儿，然后暗京楼集结的地方就爆炸了。”“再然后，暗京楼的精锐就全部炸死了。”他比画了半天，也说不清楚怎么回事，这事太匪夷所思，连他得到消息也像是听天书一样。总结起来不复杂，就一句话：唐逸一刀劈出，顿时天崩地裂，天雷滚滚，将暗京楼所有高手全部屠戮。可这特娘的听上去就很扯淡，谁信啊？宗师都做不到的事，他唐逸做到了！
content_en: Tang Yi was stunned.Is the Dog Emperor so sinister?It is estimated that those betrayed ministers are still glad that the emperor has forgotten them.Little did they know that the emperor, this old yin critic, had forgotten them, and had already planned to confiscate their homes justifiably, not only to take their lives, but also to take their money.At this time, Tang Yicai really believed that the emperor was really poor and crazy!"Tang Yi, congratulations!" At this time, Kong Shilan had already walked up to Tang Yi, with a complicated face: "Congratulations on winning the first place in the Shenyuan Poetry Society. Congratulations to you...um, Mr. Marquis?" Tang Yi didn't notice Kong Shilan's emotions, smiled and waved his hand: "Miss Tang, please call me Tang.Yiba, Lord Marquis, I don’t feel comfortable hearing that.”At this point, he cupped his hands and said, “Congratulations to the girl, you finally got what you wanted, and you can get married freely in the future.”Upon hearing this, Kong Shilan’s fingertips trembled subconsciously, and even his breathing became temporarily stagnant.Yes, I finally got what I wanted.However, she really has no relationship with the mysterious young man in front of her."Sorry, I'm leaving first." Tang Yi smiled and said goodbye to Kong Shilan, and quickly left the trestle.Tang Yin and Du Lingfei were already waiting outside the trestle.When passing by Kong Shilan, Kong Shilan subconsciously wanted to reach out to stop him.But before he even lifted his hand, he froze.Keep?What excuses and reasons does she have to keep Tang Yi?She was the one who said she would not marry Tang Yi at the beginning, and she was the one who said she wanted a marriage contract since she was a child and would not accept finger-marriage.Looking up at the young man's retreating back, Kong Shilan pursed her lips slightly, feeling completely confused."Brother, I want to eat roast duck. Sister Du said she knows a delicious roast duck restaurant in Kyoto." As soon as Tang Yi walked to the river, Tang Yin stared at him with her hands on her hips and her head raised: "Don't refuse, we are celebrating, brother, your promotion to one, two, three, four..." She stretched out two fingers and gestured for a long time before counting clearly.Tang Yin waved his little hands irritably, and said angrily: "Oh, I'm so tired of counting. In short, I have been promoted to many, many levels. Mom is no longer here, so I have to celebrate for my brother." Tang Yi looked at Du Lingfei, who immediately shook his head with a smile: "I didn't teach you this, I swear." Tang Yi: Haha!If you hadn't added the word "swear", maybe I would actually believe it.Swearing is a lie."Since it's a celebration, let's buy groceries and cook them ourselves. I'll cook for you." Tang Yi picked up Tang Yin, but found that the little guy was a lot heavier. He immediately became angry and said, "How much have you eaten? Your stomach can't withstand such a torment now. Just take it easy." Tang Yin immediately asked Du Lingfei for help.Du Lingfei followed Tang Yi, covered her lips and smiled: "I didn't eat much, I just ate up two tables, one of which was His Majesty's." "Forget it, she was very considerate and gave a chicken leg to His Majesty in private, and His Majesty took it." "You didn't see how wonderful Chen Diao Si's face was at that time..." After hearing Du Lingfei's complaint, Tang Yin immediately buried his head in Tang Yi's neck, saying that he knew he was wrong.After the three of them got on the stone bridge, Tang Yi even held Du Lingfei's hand, fearing that she would be frightened by the broken arm of the Anjing Tower killer.Kong Shilan watched this scene from a distance, pursed her lips slightly, and felt some inexplicable envy in her heart."No, after returning to the palace, I will ask my mother-in-law to transfer Sister Du back to the palace." The sound of Xiao Lan's gritted teeth came from beside her.Kong Shilan turned around and saw Xiao Lan standing beside her, holding a pink fist and staring at Tang Yi and Du Lingfei who were walking away."Transferred back to the palace? Miss Du was sent by the Concubine Xian to take care of Tang Yin. At the same time, she also came to help Tang Yi cultivate that... penicillin bacteria." Kong Shilan calmed down her emotions, raised her hand and knocked Xiao Lan on the forehead, saying: "Don't be ridiculous., Penicillin solution is the only medicine that can cure your disease, there is no room for error."Let's go, Shen Yuan is full of blood now, it's not good for you to stay here."Xiao Lan pouted looking at the backs of Tang Yi and Du Lingfei, and stamped his feet angrily.How annoying.After finally snatching food from Sister Kong's mouth, Sister Du appeared again to fight for food and steal his child and father....Tianxiang Tower.From the side, Wei Yuan is holding a wine pot and still sitting under the old locust tree.Opposite him, a girl in a wheelchair was holding a book and reading it seriously. Wei Yuan stared at him, his face full of love and doting."Ancestor, there is news from Shen Yuan." At this time, Wei Hai walked over quickly.Stopping under the locust tree, Wei Hai looked at the girl subconsciously and hesitated to speak.Wei Yuan raised his hand and said, "It doesn't matter. Let's talk. You don't have to carry Ling'er on your back." "It's faster than I expected. It seems that your Majesty is well prepared this time." After hearing this, Wei Hai's face suddenly became weird.He shook his head and said, "Ancestor, I have nothing to do with Your Majesty... Before An Jinglou went on a killing spree, Tang Yi killed almost the entire army." "Huh?!" Wei Yuan suddenly raised his head, his eyes suddenly sharp.An Jinglou hadn't even gone on a killing spree, but Tang Yi had killed the entire army and annihilated him?Are you kidding me?In order to kill Emperor Yan Wen, An Jing Tower sent out almost half of its elite troops. It was not difficult to flatten a Shen Garden or even bloodbath the palace.As a result, he was wiped out by Tang Yi?Is that guy so capable?That kid obviously doesn't know any martial arts skills!Even Wei Linger raised his head at this time and stared at Wei Hai with a pair of beautiful big eyes.Is Xiao Shixian so powerful?Not only is he good at writing poems, but he is also so good at martial arts?"Is the news confirmed?" Wei Yuan came back to his senses and spoke in a low voice.Wei Hai nodded vigorously, with disbelief and shock on his face. When he got the news, he felt that there must be a mistake.Tang Yi was a small guard with hundreds of households, and he destroyed the Anjing Tower?It sounds like nonsense.But based on all the information, he had to admit that this nonsense was actually true.Tang Yizhen defeated hundreds of masters in Anjing Tower in one battle!"It has been confirmed that it is Tang Yi." Wei Hai looked at Wei Yuan, pointed to the sky and said: "The thunder we heard before was not thunder, but the thunder caused by Tang Yi... How should I put it? These thunders were caused by Tang Yi." "He struck like this, saidLet the sword energy fly for a while, and then the place where the Anjing Tower gathers explodes."Then all the elites in the Anjing Tower are blown up."He gestured for a long time, but he couldn't explain what was going on. This was so unbelievable that even when he got the news, it was like hearing from heaven.It's not complicated to sum up, just one sentence: Tang Yi slashed out with his sword, and suddenly the sky collapsed and the earth cracked, thunder rolled from the sky,
title_en: Chapter 134 What the Grandmaster couldn’t do, he did it!
